name: @sages/pi-orchestrator
description: Sages orchestrator for pi: session hooks (setActiveTools + system-prompt overlay + once-per-session soft-mode reminder) + the `orchestrate(plan)` and `task_consume(task_id)` tools (thin shims over the `TaskBoard` domain class) + the `/brainstorm` slash command. Workflows are driven by the LLM via raw `TaskCreate` × N + `TaskExecute`; `orchestrate` collapses the standard Implement → Review shape into one call, and `task_consume` reads a completed task in a structured way, parses the Reviewer's 4-state verdict, and returns a verdict-tailored follow-up suggestion. Domain capability package, loaded by pi via standard pi.extensions.
